episodes.title: Yer Çekimi
episodes.summary: Seeking her husband Zafer's whereabouts, Fatma takes matters into her own hands and visits one of his old associates — but the meeting takes a turn.

episodes.title: Toz
episodes.summary: Bayram asks Fatma to make an illicit delivery. Bayram's secretary reports to the police. Fatma and Ismail have a searing confrontation.

episodes.title: Yüzüme Bak
episodes.summary: Fatma learns the unsettling truth about Zafer's actions following Oğuz's death. Unresolved trauma fuels Fatma's violent spiral.

episodes.title: Analar ve Oğulları
episodes.summary: The Argah family's role in Oğuz's death comes to light. Yusuf presses Fatma for the location of a murder weapon and reveals a secret about Zafer.

episodes.title: Cam Kenarı
episodes.summary: The police close in on Fatma en route to the village, but a twist of fate buys her time. Emine outmaneuvers Bayram. Fatma settles scores with Zafer.

episodes.title: Düşüş
episodes.summary: Fatma seeks justice in a blistering act — but guilt looms over her. Emine grapples with a startling revelation about Oğuz's death.
